description: This file contains functions related to Lantiq system detection and configuration setup for DSL systems in an OpenWRT based environment. It includes functions to identify system type, and configure DSL interfaces accordingly.

methods.name: lantiq_is_vdsl_system
methods.description: Determines if the current system is a VDSL system by inspecting /proc/cpuinfo for specific system types.

methods.name: lantiq_setup_dsl_helper
methods.description: Sets up the DSL interface based on detected system type, configuring either VDSL or ADSL settings accordingly.
